name: qa-security-scanning
description: Unified security scanning across five domains - SAST (semgrep-rules, sonarqube-rules, codeql-queries, language-native-sast covering the Bandit / gosec / eslint-plugin-security / PMD Apex linter family, multi-tool-finding-triage), DAST (zap-baseline, nuclei-dast), SCA (snyk-test, osv-scanner, dependabot-config, renovate-config, npm-pip-maven-audit, reachability-analyzer, cve-exploitability-triage), secrets (gitleaks-scanning, trufflehog-scanning, secrets-rotation-runner), and SBOM + container (syft-generation, sbom-formats, trivy-image, vex-author): 21 skills and 1 agent (security-finding-triager), the cross-domain adversarial unifier that normalizes, deduplicates, waiver-checks, and gates multi-scanner output - including IaC scanner output from qa-iac - into one BLOCK / PASS verdict per domain. Every scanner skill includes a mandatory False-positive triage section.
